verses.textZh: 保罗、西拉和提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠平安临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗、西拉和提摩太，写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠平安临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦在父神和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠、平安归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, Silas, and Timothy. We are writing to the church in Thessalonica, to you who belong to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. May God give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
verses.textEn: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

verses.textZh: 我们常常为你们众人感谢神，祷告的时候提到你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们常常为你们众人感谢神，祷告的时候提到你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为你们众人常常感谢神，祷告的时候提到你们，
verses.textEnNiv: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.
verses.textEnEsv: We give thanks to God always for all of you, constantly mentioning you in our prayers,
verses.textEnNkjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers,
verses.textEnNlt: We always thank God for all of you and pray for you constantly.
verses.textEnNasb: We always give thanks to God for all of you, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.textEn: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.

verses.textZh: 在我们的父神面前，不住地记念你们信心的工作，爱心的劳苦和因盼望我们主耶稣基督而有的坚忍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我们的父神面前，不住地记念你们信心的工作，爱心的劳苦和因盼望我们主耶稣基督而有的坚忍。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神－我们的父面前，不住地记念你们因信心所做的工夫，因爱心所受的劳苦，因盼望我们主耶稣基督所存的忍耐。
verses.textEnNiv: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: remembering before our God and Father your work of faith and labor of love and steadfastness of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: remembering without ceasing your work of faith, labor of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ in the sight of our God and Father,
verses.textEnNlt: As we pray to our God and Father about you, we think of your faithful work, your loving deeds, and the enduring hope you have because of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: constantly keeping in mind your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ in the presence of our God and Father,
verses.textEn: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 神所爱的弟兄们，我们知道你们是蒙拣选的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所爱的弟兄们，我们知道你们是蒙拣选的，
verses.textZhCuv: 被神所爱的弟兄啊，我知道你们是蒙拣选的；
verses.textEnNiv: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,
verses.textEnEsv: For we know, brothers loved by God, that he has chosen you,
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing, beloved brethren, your election by God.
verses.textEnNlt: We know, dear brothers and sisters, that God loves you and has chosen you to be his own people.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing, brothers and sisters, beloved by God, His choice of you;
verses.textEn: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,

verses.textZh: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不单是借着言语，也是借着权能，借着圣灵和充足的信心。为了你们的缘故，我们在你们中间为人怎样，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不单是借着言语，也是借着权能，借着圣灵和充足的信心。为了你们的缘故，我们在你们中间为人怎样，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不独在乎言语，也在乎权能和圣灵，并充足的信心。正如你们知道，我们在你们那里，为你们的缘故是怎样为人。
verses.textEnNiv: because our gospel came to you not simply with words but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.
verses.textEnEsv: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction. You know what kind of men we proved to be among you for your sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and in much assurance, as you know what kind of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.textEnNlt: For when we brought you the Good News, it was not only with words but also with power, for the Holy Spirit gave you full assurance that what we said was true. And you know of our concern for you from the way we lived when we were with you.
verses.textEnNasb: for our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction; just as you know what kind of men we proved to be among you for your sakes.
verses.textEn: because our gospel came to you not simply with words but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.

verses.textZh: 你们效法了我们，也效法了主，在大患难中，带着圣灵的喜乐接受了真道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们效法了我们，也效法了主，在大患难中，带着圣灵的喜乐接受了真道。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们在大难之中，蒙了圣灵所赐的喜乐，领受真道就效法我们，也效法了主；
verses.textEnNiv: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you received the word in much affliction, with the joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you became followers of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: So you received the message with joy from the Holy Spirit in spite of the severe suffering it brought you. In this way, you imitated both us and the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: You also became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word during great affliction with the joy of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们就成了马其顿和亚该亚所有信徒的榜样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们就成了马其顿和亚该亚所有信徒的榜样。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至你们作了马其顿和亚该亚所有信主之人的榜样。
verses.textEnNiv: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.textEnEsv: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that you became examples to all in Macedonia and Achaia who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Greece—throughout both Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.textEn: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.textZh: 因为不单主的道从你们那里传遍了马其顿和亚该亚，就是你们对神的信心也传遍了各处，所以我们不用再说甚么了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为不单主的道从你们那里传遍了马其顿和亚该亚，就是你们对神的信心也传遍了各处，所以我们不用再说甚么了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主的道从你们那里已经传扬出来。你们向神的信心不但在马其顿和亚该亚，就是在各处也都传开了，所以不用我们说什么话。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord’s message rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia—your faith in God has become known everywhere. Therefore we do not need to say anything about it,
verses.textEnEsv: For not only has the word of the Lord sounded forth from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone forth everywhere, so that we need not say anything.
verses.textEnNkjv: For from you the word of the Lord has sounded forth, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place. Your faith toward God has gone out, so that we do not need to say anything.
verses.textEnNlt: And now the word of the Lord is ringing out from you to people everywhere, even beyond Macedonia and Achaia, for wherever we go we find people telling us about your faith in God. We don’t need to tell them about it,
verses.textEnNasb: For the word of the Lord has sounded forth from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place the news of your faith toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.
verses.textEn: The Lord’s message rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia—your faith in God has become known everywhere. Therefore we do not need to say anything about it,

verses.textZh: 他们都述说你们是怎样接待我们，而且怎样离弃偶像归向神，要服事这位又真又活的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都述说你们是怎样接待我们，而且怎样离弃偶像归向神，要服事这位又真又活的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们自己已经报明我们是怎样进到你们那里，你们是怎样离弃偶像，归向神，要服事那又真又活的神，
verses.textEnNiv: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
verses.textEnEsv: For they themselves report concerning us the kind of reception we had among you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
verses.textEnNkjv: For they themselves declare concerning us what manner of entry we had to you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,
verses.textEnNlt: for they keep talking about the wonderful welcome you gave us and how you turned away from idols to serve the living and true God.
verses.textEnNasb: For they themselves report about us as to the kind of reception we had with you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
verses.textEn: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

verses.textZh: 并且等候他的儿子从天降临。这就是神使他从死人中复活，救我们脱离将来的忿怒的那位耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且等候他的儿子从天降临。这就是神使他从死人中复活，救我们脱离将来的忿怒的那位耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 等候他儿子从天降临，就是他从死里复活的－那位救我们脱离将来忿怒的耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, Jesus who delivers us from the wrath to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to wait for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead, even Jesus who delivers us from the wrath to come.
verses.textEnNlt: And they speak of how you are looking forward to the coming of God’s Son from heaven—Jesus, whom God raised from the dead. He is the one who has rescued us from the terrors of the coming judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: and to wait for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead, that is, Jesus who rescues us from the wrath to come.
verses.textEn: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们都知道，我们进到你们那里，并不是白费工夫的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们都知道，我们进到你们那里，并不是白费工夫的。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们自己原晓得我们进到你们那里并不是徒然的。
verses.textEnNiv: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.
verses.textEnEsv: For you yourselves know, brothers, that our coming to you was not in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you yourselves know, brethren, that our coming to you was not in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: You yourselves know, dear brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not a failure.
verses.textEnNasb: For you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, that our reception among you was not in vain,
verses.textEn: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.

verses.textZh: 我们从前在腓立比虽然受了苦，又被凌辱，可是靠着我们的神，在强烈的反对之下，仍然放胆向你们述说神的福音，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前在腓立比虽然受了苦，又被凌辱，可是靠着我们的神，在强烈的反对之下，仍然放胆向你们述说神的福音，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从前在腓立比被害受辱，这是你们知道的；然而还是靠我们的神放开胆量，在大争战中把神的福音传给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: We had previously suffered and been treated outrageously in Philippi, as you know, but with the help of our God we dared to tell you his gospel in the face of strong opposition.
verses.textEnEsv: But though we had already suffered and been shamefully treated at Philippi, as you know, we had boldness in our God to declare to you the gospel of God in the midst of much conflict.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even after we had suffered before and were spitefully treated at Philippi, as you know, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God in much conflict.
verses.textEnNlt: You know how badly we had been treated at Philippi just before we came to you and how much we suffered there. Yet our God gave us the courage to declare his Good News to you boldly, in spite of great opposition.
verses.textEnNasb: but after we had already suffered and been treated abusively in Philippi, as you know, we had the boldness in our God to speak to you the gospel of God amid much opposition.
verses.textEn: We had previously suffered and been treated outrageously in Philippi, as you know, but with the help of our God we dared to tell you his gospel in the face of strong opposition.

verses.textZh: 我们的呼吁，不是错谬的，不是污秽的，也没有诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的呼吁，不是错谬的，不是污秽的，也没有诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的劝勉不是出于错误，不是出于污秽，也不是用诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.
verses.textEnEsv: For our appeal does not spring from error or impurity or any attempt to deceive,
verses.textEnNkjv: For our exhortation did not come from error or uncleanness, nor wasit in deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: So you can see we were not preaching with any deceit or impure motives or trickery.
verses.textEnNasb: For our exhortation does not come from error or impurity or by way of deceit;
verses.textEn: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.

verses.textZh: 相反地，神既然考验过我们，把福音委托给我们，我们就传讲，不像是讨人欢心的，而是讨那察验我们心思的神的喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 相反地，神既然考验过我们，把福音委托给我们，我们就传讲，不像是讨人欢心的，而是讨那察验我们心思的神的喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神既然验中了我们，把福音托付我们，我们就照样讲，不是要讨人喜欢，乃是要讨那察验我们心的神喜欢。
verses.textEnNiv: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not to please man, but to please God who tests our hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, even so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God who tests our hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: For we speak as messengers approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News. Our purpose is to please God, not people. He alone examines the motives of our hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not intending to please people, but to please God, who examines our hearts.
verses.textEn: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.

verses.textZh: 我们从来不说奉承的话，这是你们知道的，神可以作证，我们并没有借故起贪心，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从来不说奉承的话，这是你们知道的，神可以作证，我们并没有借故起贪心，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们从来没有用过谄媚的话，这是你们知道的；也没有藏着贪心，这是神可以作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.
verses.textEnEsv: For we never came with words of flattery, as you know, nor with a pretext for greed— God is witness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For neither at any time did we use flattering words, as you know, nor a cloak for covetousness— God is witness.
verses.textEnNlt: Never once did we try to win you with flattery, as you well know. And God is our witness that we were not pretending to be your friends just to get your money!
verses.textEnNasb: For we never came with flattering speech, as you know, nor with a pretext for greed—God is our witness—
verses.textEn: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.

verses.textZh: 我们这样疼爱你们，不但乐意把神的福音传给你们，连自己的性命也乐意给你们，因为你们是我们所爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们这样疼爱你们，不但乐意把神的福音传给你们，连自己的性命也乐意给你们，因为你们是我们所爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们作基督的使徒，虽然可以叫人尊重，却没有向你们或向别人求荣耀；
verses.textEnNiv: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.
verses.textEnEsv: Nor did we seek glory from people, whether from you or from others, though we could have made demands as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor did we seek glory from men, either from you or from others, when we might have made demands as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: As for human praise, we have never sought it from you or anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: nor did we seek honor from people, either from you or from others, though we could have asserted our authority as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEn: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们应该记得我们的辛苦和劳碌；我们把神的福音传给你们的时候，怎样昼夜作工，免得你们有人受累。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们应该记得我们的辛苦和劳碌；我们把神的福音传给你们的时候，怎样昼夜作工，免得你们有人受累。
verses.textZhCuv: 只在你们中间存心温柔，如同母亲乳养自己的孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, we were like young children among you. Just as a nursing mother cares for her children,
verses.textEnEsv: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother taking care of her own children.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we were gentle among you, just as a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
verses.textEnNlt: As apostles of Christ we certainly had a right to make some demands of you, but instead we were like children among you. Or we were like a mother feeding and caring for her own children.
verses.textEnNasb: But we proved to be gentle among you. As a nursing mother tenderly cares for her own children,
verses.textEn: Instead, we were like young children among you. Just as a nursing mother cares for her children,

verses.textZh: 我们对你们信的人是多么圣洁、公义、无可指摘，这是你们和神都可以作证的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们对你们信的人是多么圣洁、公义、无可指摘，这是你们和神都可以作证的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既是这样爱你们，不但愿意将神的福音给你们，连自己的性命也愿意给你们，因你们是我们所疼爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: so we cared for you. Because we loved you so much, we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our lives as well.
verses.textEnEsv: So, being affectionately desirous of you, we were ready to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own selves, because you had become very dear to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not only the gospel of God, but also our own lives, because you had become dear to us.
verses.textEnNlt: We loved you so much that we shared with you not only God’s Good News but our own lives, too.
verses.textEnNasb: in the same way we had a fond affection for you and were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but also our own lives, because you had become very dear to us.
verses.textEn: so we cared for you. Because we loved you so much, we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our lives as well.

verses.textZh: 正如你们知道的，我们是怎样好象父亲对待儿女一样对待你们各人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如你们知道的，我们是怎样好象父亲对待儿女一样对待你们各人：
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们记念我们的辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，传神的福音给你们，免得叫你们一人受累。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you remember, brothers and sisters, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you remember, brothers, our labor and toil: we worked night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you, while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you remember, brethren, our labor and toil; for laboring night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you, we preached to you the gospel of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you remember, dear brothers and sisters, how hard we worked among you? Night and day we toiled to earn a living so that we would not be a burden to any of you as we preached God’s Good News to you.
verses.textEnNasb: For you recall, brothers and sisters, our labor and hardship: it was by working night and day so as not to be a burden to any of you, that we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
verses.textEn: Surely you remember, brothers and sisters, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.

verses.textZh: 劝勉你们，鼓励你们，叮嘱你们，要你们行事为人，配得上那召你们进入他的国和荣耀的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劝勉你们，鼓励你们，叮嘱你们，要你们行事为人，配得上那召你们进入他的国和荣耀的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们向你们信主的人，是何等圣洁、公义、无可指摘，有你们作见证，也有神作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.
verses.textEnEsv: You are witnesses, and God also, how holy and righteous and blameless was our conduct toward you believers.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are witnesses, and God also, how devoutly and justly and blamelessly we behaved ourselves among you who believe;
verses.textEnNlt: You yourselves are our witnesses—and so is God—that we were devout and honest and faultless toward all of you believers.
verses.textEnNasb: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how devoutly and rightly and blamelessly we behaved toward you believers;
verses.textEn: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.

verses.textZh: 我们也为这缘故不住感谢神，因为你们接受了我们所传的神的道，不认为这是人的道，而认为这确实是神的道。这道也运行在你们信的人里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也为这缘故不住感谢神，因为你们接受了我们所传的神的道，不认为这是人的道，而认为这确实是神的道。这道也运行在你们信的人里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也晓得，我们怎样劝勉你们，安慰你们，嘱咐你们各人，好像父亲待自己的儿女一样，
verses.textEnNiv: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,
verses.textEnEsv: For you know how, like a father with his children,
verses.textEnNkjv: as you know how we exhorted, and comforted, and charged every one of you, as a father does his own children,
verses.textEnNlt: And you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children.
verses.textEnNasb: just as you know how we were exhorting and encouraging and imploring each one of you as a father would his own children,
verses.textEn: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，你们好象犹太地在基督耶稣里神的众教会一样，他们怎样遭受犹太人的迫害，你们也照样遭受同族人的迫害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，你们好象犹太地在基督耶稣里神的众教会一样，他们怎样遭受犹太人的迫害，你们也照样遭受同族人的迫害。
verses.textZhCuv: 要叫你们行事对得起那召你们进他国、得他荣耀的神。
verses.textEnNiv: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.
verses.textEnEsv: we exhorted each one of you and encouraged you and charged you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into his own kingdom and glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you would walk worthy of God who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
verses.textEnNlt: We pleaded with you, encouraged you, and urged you to live your lives in a way that God would consider worthy. For he called you to share in his Kingdom and glory.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you would walk in a manner worthy of the God who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
verses.textEn: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.

verses.textZh: 这些犹太人杀了主耶稣和众先知，又把我们赶出来。他们得不到神的喜悦，并且和所有的人作对，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些犹太人杀了主耶稣和众先知，又把我们赶出来。他们得不到神的喜悦，并且和所有的人作对，
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，我们也不住地感谢神，因你们听见我们所传神的道就领受了；不以为是人的道，乃以为是神的道。这道实在是神的，并且运行在你们信主的人心中。
verses.textEnNiv: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.
verses.textEnEsv: And we also thank God constantly for this, that when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men but as what it really is, the word of God, which is at work in you believers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason we also thank God without ceasing, because when you received the word of God which you heard from us, you welcomed it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which also effectively works in you who believe.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, we never stop thanking God that when you received his message from us, you didn’t think of our words as mere human ideas. You accepted what we said as the very word of God—which, of course, it is. And this word continues to work in you who believe.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason we also constantly thank God that when you received the word of God which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of mere men, but as what it really is, the word of God, which also is at work in you who believe.
verses.textEn: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.

verses.textZh: 阻挠我们向外族人传道，不让他们得救，以致恶贯满盈。神的忿怒终必临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阻挠我们向外族人传道，不让他们得救，以致恶贯满盈。神的忿怒终必临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们曾效法犹太中在基督耶稣里神的各教会；因为你们也受了本地人的苦害，像他们受了犹太人的苦害一样。
verses.textEnNiv: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own people the same things those churches suffered from the Jews
verses.textEnEsv: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in Judea. For you suffered the same things from your own countrymen as they did from the Jews,
verses.textEnNkjv: For you, brethren, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus. For you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, just as they did from the Judeans,
verses.textEnNlt: And then, dear brothers and sisters, you suffered persecution from your own countrymen. In this way, you imitated the believers in God’s churches in Judea who, because of their belief in Christ Jesus, suffered from their own people, the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in Judea, for you also endured the same sufferings at the hands of your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews,
verses.textEn: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own people the same things those churches suffered from the Jews

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们被迫暂时离开你们，不过是身体离开，心却没有离开。我们非常渴望再见到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们被迫暂时离开你们，不过是身体离开，心却没有离开。我们非常渴望再见到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这犹太人杀了主耶稣和先知，又把我们赶出去。他们不得神的喜悦，且与众人为敌，
verses.textEnNiv: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone
verses.textEnEsv: who killed both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove us out, and displease God and oppose all mankind
verses.textEnNkjv: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they do not please God and are contrary to all men,
verses.textEnNlt: For some of the Jews killed the prophets, and some even killed the Lord Jesus. Now they have persecuted us, too. They fail to please God and work against all humanity
verses.textEnNasb: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and drove us out. They are not pleasing to God, but hostile to all people,
verses.textEn: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone

verses.textZh: 因此，我们很想到你们那里去，我保罗也一再想去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们很想到你们那里去，我保罗也一再想去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 不许我们传道给外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充满自己的罪恶。神的忿怒临在他们身上已经到了极处。
verses.textEnNiv: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.
verses.textEnEsv: by hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles that they might be saved—so as always to fill up the measure of their sins. But wrath has come upon them at last!
verses.textEnNkjv: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, so as always to fill up themeasureof their sins; but wrath has come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.textEnNlt: as they try to keep us from preaching the Good News of salvation to the Gentiles. By doing this, they continue to pile up their sins. But the anger of God has caught up with them at last.
verses.textEnNasb: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved; with the result that they always reach the limit of their sins. But wrath has come upon them fully.
verses.textEn: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.

verses.textZh: 我们主耶稣再来的时候，我们在他面前的盼望、喜乐或所夸耀的冠冕是甚么呢？不就是你们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们主耶稣再来的时候，我们在他面前的盼望、喜乐或所夸耀的冠冕是甚么呢？不就是你们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们暂时与你们离别，是面目离别，心里却不离别；我们极力地想法子，很愿意见你们的面。
verses.textEnNiv: But, brothers and sisters, when we were orphaned by being separated from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.
verses.textEnEsv: But since we were torn away from you, brothers, for a short time, in person not in heart, we endeavored the more eagerly and with great desire to see you face to face,
verses.textEnNkjv: But we, brethren, having been taken away from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavored more eagerly to see your face with great desire.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, after we were separated from you for a little while (though our hearts never left you), we tried very hard to come back because of our intense longing to see you again.
verses.textEnNasb: But we, brothers and sisters, having been orphaned from you by absence for a short while—in person, not in spirit—were all the more eager with great desire to see your face.
verses.textEn: But, brothers and sisters, when we were orphaned by being separated from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.

verses.textZh: 是的，你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是的，你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们有意到你们那里；我－保罗有一两次要去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.
verses.textEnEsv: because we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, again and again—but Satan hindered us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we wanted to come to you—even I, Paul, time and again—but Satan hindered us.
verses.textEnNlt: We wanted very much to come to you, and I, Paul, tried again and again, but Satan prevented us.
verses.textEnNasb: For we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, more than once—and Satan hindered us.
verses.textEn: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.

verses.textZh: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候、你们在他面前站立得住吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候、你们在他面前站立得住吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候、你们在他面前站立得住吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?
verses.textEnEsv: For what is our hope or joy or crown of boasting before our Lord Jesus at his coming? Is it not you?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isit not even you in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?
verses.textEnNlt: After all, what gives us hope and joy, and what will be our proud reward and crown as we stand before our Lord Jesus when he returns? It is you!
verses.textEnNasb: For who is our hope, or joy or crown of pride, in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming? Or is it not indeed you?
verses.textEn: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?

verses.textZh: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are our glory and joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you are our glory and joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you are our pride and joy.
verses.textEnNasb: For you are our glory and joy.
verses.textEn: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.

verses.textZh: 我们既然不能再忍下去，就决定留在雅典，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然不能再忍下去，就决定留在雅典，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既不能再忍，就愿意独自等在雅典，
verses.textEnNiv: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left behind at Athens alone,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when we could no longer endure it, we thought it good to be left in Athens alone,
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, when we could stand it no longer, we decided to stay alone in Athens,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, when we could no longer endure it, we thought it best to be left behind, alone at Athens,
verses.textEn: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.

verses.textZh: 派我们的弟兄，就是在基督的福音上和神同工的提摩太去，为了要在你们的信仰上坚定你们，劝慰你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 派我们的弟兄，就是在基督的福音上和神同工的提摩太去，为了要在你们的信仰上坚定你们，劝慰你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 打发我们的兄弟在基督福音上作神执事的 提摩太前去，坚固你们，并在你们所信的道上劝慰你们，
verses.textEnNiv: We sent Timothy, who is our brother and co-worker in God’s service in spreading the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
verses.textEnEsv: and we sent Timothy, our brother and God’s coworker in the gospel of Christ, to establish and exhort you in your faith,
verses.textEnNkjv: and sent Timothy, our brother and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you and encourage you concerning your faith,
verses.textEnNlt: and we sent Timothy to visit you. He is our brother and God’s co-worker in proclaiming the Good News of Christ. We sent him to strengthen you, to encourage you in your faith,
verses.textEnNasb: and we sent Timothy, our brother and God’s fellow worker in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you for the benefit of your faith,
verses.textEn: We sent Timothy, who is our brother and co-worker in God’s service in spreading the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,

verses.textZh: 免得有人在各样的患难中动摇了。你们自己知道，我们受患难原是命定的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得有人在各样的患难中动摇了。你们自己知道，我们受患难原是命定的。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得有人被诸般患难摇动。因为你们自己知道，我们受患难原是命定的。
verses.textEnNiv: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.
verses.textEnEsv: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are destined for this.
verses.textEnNkjv: that no one should be shaken by these afflictions; for you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
verses.textEnNlt: and to keep you from being shaken by the troubles you were going through. But you know that we are destined for such troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: so that no one would be disturbed by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we have been destined for this.
verses.textEn: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.

verses.textZh: 我们在你们那里的时候，早已对你们说过，我们将会遭受患难。后来应验了，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在你们那里的时候，早已对你们说过，我们将会遭受患难。后来应验了，这是你们知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在你们那里的时候，预先告诉你们，我们必受患难，以后果然应验了，你们也知道。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.
verses.textEnEsv: For when we were with you, we kept telling you beforehand that we were to suffer affliction, just as it has come to pass, and just as you know.
verses.textEnNkjv: For, in fact, we told you before when we were with you that we would suffer tribulation, just as it happened, and you know.
verses.textEnNlt: Even while we were with you, we warned you that troubles would soon come—and they did, as you well know.
verses.textEnNasb: For even when we were with you, we kept telling you in advance that we were going to suffer affliction; and so it happened, as you know.
verses.textEn: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.

verses.textZh: 因此，我既然不能再忍下去，就派人去打听你们的信心怎样；恐怕那试探人的诱惑了你们，以致我们的劳苦白费了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我既然不能再忍下去，就派人去打听你们的信心怎样；恐怕那试探人的诱惑了你们，以致我们的劳苦白费了。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，我既不能再忍，就打发人去，要晓得你们的信心如何，恐怕那诱惑人的到底诱惑了你们，叫我们的劳苦归于徒然。
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter had tempted you and that our labors might have been in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to learn about your faith, for fear that somehow the tempter had tempted you and our labor would be in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason, when I could no longer endure it, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor might be in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why, when I could bear it no longer, I sent Timothy to find out whether your faith was still strong. I was afraid that the tempter had gotten the best of you and that our work had been useless.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason, when I could no longer endure it, I also sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter might have tempted you, and our labor would be for nothing.
verses.textEn: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter had tempted you and that our labors might have been in vain.

verses.textZh: 提摩太刚刚从你们那里回来，把你们信心和爱心的好消息带给我们。他还说，你们常常怀念我们，切切想见我们，好象我们想见你们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提摩太刚刚从你们那里回来，把你们信心和爱心的好消息带给我们。他还说，你们常常怀念我们，切切想见我们，好象我们想见你们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但提摩太刚才从你们那里回来，将你们信心和爱心的好消息报给我们，又说你们常常记念我们，切切地想见我们，如同我们想见你们一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.
verses.textEnEsv: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has brought us the good news of your faith and love and reported that you always remember us kindly and long to see us, as we long to see you—
verses.textEnNkjv: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and brought us good news of your faith and love, and that you always have good remembrance of us, greatly desiring to see us, as we also tosee you—
verses.textEnNlt: But now Timothy has just returned, bringing us good news about your faith and love. He reports that you always remember our visit with joy and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
verses.textEnNasb: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has brought us good news of your faith and love, and that you always think kindly of us, longing to see us just as we also long to see you,
verses.textEn: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，我们在这一切困苦患难中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，我们在这一切困苦患难中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，弟兄们，我们在一切困苦患难之中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.
verses.textEnEsv: for this reason, brothers, in all our distress and affliction we have been comforted about you through your faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, brethren, in all our affliction and distress we were comforted concerning you by your faith.
verses.textEnNlt: So we have been greatly encouraged in the midst of our troubles and suffering, dear brothers and sisters, because you have remained strong in your faith.
verses.textEnNasb: for this reason, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and affliction we were comforted about you through your faith;
verses.textEn: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.

verses.textZh: 如果你们在主里站立得稳，我们就可以活下去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们在主里站立得稳，我们就可以活下去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若靠主站立得稳，我们就活了。
verses.textEnNiv: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: For now we live, if you are standing fast in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: It gives us new life to know that you are standing firm in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: for now we really live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
verses.textEn: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 我们因你们的缘故，在我们的神面前满有喜乐；为这一切喜乐，我们可以为你们向神献上怎么样的感谢呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因你们的缘故，在我们的神面前满有喜乐；为这一切喜乐，我们可以为你们向神献上怎么样的感谢呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在神面前，因着你们甚是喜乐；为这一切喜乐，可用何等的感谢为你们报答神呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?
verses.textEnEsv: For what thanksgiving can we return to God for you, for all the joy that we feel for your sake before our God,
verses.textEnNkjv: For what thanks can we render to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sake before our God,
verses.textEnNlt: How we thank God for you! Because of you we have great joy as we enter God’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: For what thanks can we give to God for you in return for all the joy with which we rejoice because of you before our God,
verses.textEn: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?

verses.textZh: 我们昼夜迫切祈求，要见你们的面，并且要补满你们信心的不足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们昼夜迫切祈求，要见你们的面，并且要补满你们信心的不足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们昼夜切切地祈求，要见你们的面，补满你们信心的不足。
verses.textEnNiv: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.
verses.textEnEsv: as we pray most earnestly night and day that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith?
verses.textEnNkjv: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and perfect what is lacking in your faith?
verses.textEnNlt: Night and day we pray earnestly for you, asking God to let us see you again to fill the gaps in your faith.
verses.textEnNasb: as we keep praying most earnestly night and day that we may see your faces, and may complete what is lacking in your faith?
verses.textEn: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.

verses.textZh: 愿我们的父神自己和我们的主耶稣为我们开路，使我们可以到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我们的父神自己和我们的主耶稣为我们开路，使我们可以到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿神－我们的父和我们的主耶稣一直引领我们到你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and our Lord Jesus bring us to you very soon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you;
verses.textEn: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.

verses.textZh: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，和爱众人的心，都充充足足，多而又多，好象我们爱你们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，和爱众人的心，都充充足足，多而又多，好象我们爱你们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，并爱众人的心都能增长，充足，如同我们爱你们一样，
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.
verses.textEnEsv: and may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, as we do for you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And may the Lord make you increase and abound in love to one another and to all, just as we do to you,
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord make your love for one another and for all people grow and overflow, just as our love for you overflows.
verses.textEnNasb: and may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow in love for one another, and for all people, just as we also do for you;
verses.textEn: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

verses.textZh: 也愿他坚定你们的心，好叫你们在我们主耶稣和众圣徒再来的时候，在我们的父神面前，完全圣洁，无可指摘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也愿他坚定你们的心，好叫你们在我们主耶稣和众圣徒再来的时候，在我们的父神面前，完全圣洁，无可指摘。
verses.textZhCuv: 好使你们当我们主耶稣同他众圣徒来的时候，在我们父神面前，心里坚固，成为圣洁，无可责备。
verses.textEnNiv: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.
verses.textEnEsv: so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that He may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.
verses.textEnNlt: May he, as a result, make your hearts strong, blameless, and holy as you stand before God our Father when our Lord Jesus comes again with all his holy people. Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: so that He may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.
verses.textEn: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.

verses.textZh: 此外，弟兄们，我们在主耶稣里求你们，劝你们，你们既然接受了我们的教训，知道应该怎样行事为人，并且怎样讨神喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的更进一步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，弟兄们，我们在主耶稣里求你们，劝你们，你们既然接受了我们的教训，知道应该怎样行事为人，并且怎样讨神喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的更进一步。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我还有话说：我们靠着主耶稣求你们，劝你们，你们既然受了我们的教训，知道该怎样行可以讨神的喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的更加勉励。
verses.textEnNiv: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, then, brothers, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, just as you are doing, that you do so more and more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally then, brethren, we urge and exhort in the Lord Jesus that you should abound more and more, just as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God;
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you in the name of the Lord Jesus to live in a way that pleases God, as we have taught you. You live this way already, and we encourage you to do so even more.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally then, brothers and sisters, we request and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received instruction from us as to how you ought to walk and please God (just as you actually do walk), that you excel even more.
verses.textEn: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.

verses.textZh: 我们凭着主耶稣传给你们的是甚么命令，你们是知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们凭着主耶稣传给你们的是甚么命令，你们是知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们原晓得，我们凭主耶稣传给你们什么命令。
verses.textEnNiv: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: for you know what commandments we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: For you remember what we taught you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 神的旨意是要你们圣洁，远避淫行；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的旨意是要你们圣洁，远避淫行；
verses.textZhCuv: 神的旨意就是要你们成为圣洁，远避淫行；
verses.textEnNiv: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality;
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you should abstain from sexual immorality;
verses.textEnNlt: God’s will is for you to be holy, so stay away from all sexual sin.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the will of God, your sanctification; that is, that you abstain from sexual immorality;
verses.textEn: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

verses.textZh: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁尊贵的方法保守自己的身体 ；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁尊贵的方法保守自己的身体 ；
verses.textZhCuv: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁、尊贵守着自己的身体，
verses.textEnNiv: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,
verses.textEnEsv: that each one of you know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
verses.textEnNkjv: that each of you should know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
verses.textEnNlt: Then each of you will control his own body and live in holiness and honor—
verses.textEnNasb: that each of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
verses.textEn: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,

verses.textZh: 不要放纵邪情私欲，像那些不认识神的外族人一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要放纵邪情私欲，像那些不认识神的外族人一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 不放纵私欲的邪情，像那不认识神的外邦人。
verses.textEnNiv: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;
verses.textEnEsv: not in the passion of lust like the Gentiles who do not know God;
verses.textEnNkjv: not in passion of lust, like the Gentiles who do not know God;
verses.textEnNlt: not in lustful passion like the pagans who do not know God and his ways.
verses.textEnNasb: not in lustful passion, like the Gentiles who do not know God;
verses.textEn: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;

verses.textZh: 谁也不要在这事上越轨，占弟兄的便宜，因为这一类的事，主必报应。这是我们从前告诉过你们，又严严警戒过你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁也不要在这事上越轨，占弟兄的便宜，因为这一类的事，主必报应。这是我们从前告诉过你们，又严严警戒过你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要一个人在这事上越分，欺负他的弟兄；因为这一类的事，主必报应，正如我预先对你们说过、又切切嘱咐你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: and that in this matter no one should wrong or take advantage of a brother or sister. The Lord will punish all those who commit such sins, as we told you and warned you before.
verses.textEnEsv: that no one transgress and wrong his brother in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as we told you beforehand and solemnly warned you.
verses.textEnNkjv: that no one should take advantage of and defraud his brother in this matter, because the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also forewarned you and testified.
verses.textEnNlt: Never harm or cheat a fellow believer in this matter by violating his wife, for the Lord avenges all such sins, as we have solemnly warned you before.
verses.textEnNasb: and that no one violate the rights and take advantage of his brother or sister in the matter, because the Lord is the avenger in all these things, just as we also told you previously and solemnly warned you.
verses.textEn: and that in this matter no one should wrong or take advantage of a brother or sister. The Lord will punish all those who commit such sins, as we told you and warned you before.

verses.textZh: 神呼召我们，不是要我们沾染污秽，而是要我们圣洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神呼召我们，不是要我们沾染污秽，而是要我们圣洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 神召我们，本不是要我们沾染污秽，乃是要我们成为圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.
verses.textEnEsv: For God has not called us for impurity, but in holiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God did not call us to uncleanness, but in holiness.
verses.textEnNlt: God has called us to live holy lives, not impure lives.
verses.textEnNasb: For God has not called us for impurity, but in sanctification.
verses.textEn: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

verses.textZh: 所以那弃绝这命令的，不是弃绝人，而是弃绝把他自己的圣灵赐给你们的那位神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以那弃绝这命令的，不是弃绝人，而是弃绝把他自己的圣灵赐给你们的那位神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，那弃绝的，不是弃绝人，乃是弃绝那赐圣灵给你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore whoever disregards this, disregards not man but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he who rejects this does not reject man, but God, who has also given us His Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, anyone who refuses to live by these rules is not disobeying human teaching but is rejecting God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, the one who rejects this is not rejecting man, but the God who gives His Holy Spirit to you.
verses.textEn: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 论到弟兄相爱，用不着人写甚么给你们，因为你们自己受了神的教导，要彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到弟兄相爱，用不着人写甚么给你们，因为你们自己受了神的教导，要彼此相爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到弟兄们相爱，不用人写信给你们；因为你们自己蒙了神的教训，叫你们彼此相爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning brotherly love you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another,
verses.textEnNkjv: But concerning brotherly love you have no need that I should write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another;
verses.textEnNlt: But we don’t need to write to you about the importance of loving each other, for God himself has taught you to love one another.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as to the love of the brothers and sisters, you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another;
verses.textEn: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.

verses.textZh: 其实，你们向全马其顿所有的弟兄，已经这样行了。但是，弟兄们，我们劝你们要更加彼此相爱；
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实，你们向全马其顿所有的弟兄，已经这样行了。但是，弟兄们，我们劝你们要更加彼此相爱；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们向马其顿全地的众弟兄固然是这样行，但我劝弟兄们要更加勉励。
verses.textEnNiv: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,
verses.textEnEsv: for that indeed is what you are doing to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to do this more and more,
verses.textEnNkjv: and indeed you do so toward all the brethren who are in all Macedonia. But we urge you, brethren, that you increase more and more;
verses.textEnNlt: Indeed, you already show your love for all the believers throughout Macedonia. Even so, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you to love them even more.
verses.textEnNasb: for indeed you practice it toward all the brothers and sisters who are in all Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to excel even more,
verses.textEn: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,

verses.textZh: 又要立志过安静的生活，办自己的事，亲手作工，正如我们从前吩咐过你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要立志过安静的生活，办自己的事，亲手作工，正如我们从前吩咐过你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 又要立志作安静人，办自己的事，亲手做工，正如我们从前所吩咐你们的，
verses.textEnNiv: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,
verses.textEnEsv: and to aspire to live quietly, and to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, as we instructed you,
verses.textEnNkjv: that you also aspire to lead a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,
verses.textEnNlt: Make it your goal to live a quiet life, minding your own business and working with your hands, just as we instructed you before.
verses.textEnNasb: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life and attend to your own business and work with your hands, just as we instructed you,
verses.textEn: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,

verses.textZh: 使你们行事为人可以得到外人的尊敬，自己也不会有甚么缺乏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你们行事为人可以得到外人的尊敬，自己也不会有甚么缺乏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们可以向外人行事端正，自己也就没有什么缺乏了。
verses.textEnNiv: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.
verses.textEnEsv: so that you may walk properly before outsiders and be dependent on no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and that you may lack nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Then people who are not believers will respect the way you live, and you will not need to depend on others.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will behave properly toward outsiders and not be in any need.
verses.textEn: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，论到睡了的人，我们不愿意你们不知道，免得你们忧伤，像那些没有盼望的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，论到睡了的人，我们不愿意你们不知道，免得你们忧伤，像那些没有盼望的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到睡了的人，我们不愿意弟兄们不知道，恐怕你们忧伤，像那些没有指望的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.
verses.textEnEsv: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about those who are asleep, that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I do not want you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning those who have fallen asleep, lest you sorrow as others who have no hope.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, dear brothers and sisters, we want you to know what will happen to the believers who have died so you will not grieve like people who have no hope.
verses.textEnNasb: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who are asleep, so that you will not grieve as indeed the rest of mankind do, who have no hope.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.

verses.textZh: 我们若信耶稣死了，又复活了，照样，也应该相信那些靠着耶稣已经睡了的人，神必定把他们和耶稣一同带来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若信耶稣死了，又复活了，照样，也应该相信那些靠着耶稣已经睡了的人，神必定把他们和耶稣一同带来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若信耶稣死而复活了，那已经在耶稣里睡了的人，神也必将他们与耶稣一同带来。
verses.textEnNiv: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.
verses.textEnEsv: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so, through Jesus, God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with Him those who sleep in Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: For since we believe that Jesus died and was raised to life again, we also believe that when Jesus returns, God will bring back with him the believers who have died.
verses.textEnNasb: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose from the dead, so also God will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.
verses.textEn: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

verses.textZh: 我们现在照着主的话告诉你们：我们这些活着存留到主再来的人，绝不能在那些睡了的人以先。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们现在照着主的话告诉你们：我们这些活着存留到主再来的人，绝不能在那些睡了的人以先。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们现在照主的话告诉你们一件事：我们这活着还存留到主降临的人，断不能在那已经睡了的人之先。
verses.textEnNiv: According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnEsv: For this we declare to you by a word from the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who are asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: We tell you this directly from the Lord: We who are still living when the Lord returns will not meet him ahead of those who have died.
verses.textEnNasb: For we say this to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
verses.textEn: According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.

verses.textZh: 因为主必亲自从天降临，那时，有发令的声音，有天使长的呼声，还有神的号声，那些在基督里死了的人必先复活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主必亲自从天降临，那时，有发令的声音，有天使长的呼声，还有神的号声，那些在基督里死了的人必先复活；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有呼叫的声音和天使长的声音，又有神的号吹响；那在基督里死了的人必先复活。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a cry of command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the sound of the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a commanding shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet call of God. First, the believers who have died will rise from their graves.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
verses.textEn: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

verses.textZh: 然后，我们还活着存留的人，必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相会。这样，我们就要和主常常同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我们还活着存留的人，必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相会。这样，我们就要和主常常同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后我们这活着还存留的人必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相遇。这样，我们就要和主永远同在。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And thus we shall always be with the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, together with them, we who are still alive and remain on the earth will be caught up in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. Then we will be with the Lord forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we who are alive, who remain, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.
verses.textEn: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们应该用这些话彼此劝慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们应该用这些话彼此劝慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们当用这些话彼此劝慰。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.textEnNlt: So encourage each other with these words.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, comfort one another with these words.
verses.textEn: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，论到时候和日期，不用写甚么给你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，论到时候和日期，不用写甚么给你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，论到时候、日期，不用写信给你们，
verses.textEnNiv: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,
verses.textEnEsv: Now concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need to have anything written to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, you have no need that I should write to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Now concerning how and when all this will happen, dear brothers and sisters, we don’t really need to write you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as to the periods and times, brothers and sisters, you have no need of anything to be written to you.
verses.textEn: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,

verses.textZh: 因为你们自己清楚知道，主的日子来到，就像夜间的贼来到一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们自己清楚知道，主的日子来到，就像夜间的贼来到一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们自己明明晓得，主的日子来到，好像夜间的贼一样。
verses.textEnNiv: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
verses.textEnEsv: For you yourselves are fully aware that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: For you know quite well that the day of the Lord’s return will come unexpectedly, like a thief in the night.
verses.textEnNasb: For you yourselves know full well that the day of the Lord is coming just like a thief in the night.
verses.textEn: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

verses.textZh: 人正在说平安稳妥的时候，毁灭性的灾祸就突然临到他们，好象生产的痛苦临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人正在说平安稳妥的时候，毁灭性的灾祸就突然临到他们，好象生产的痛苦临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 人正说「平安稳妥」的时候，灾祸忽然临到他们，如同产难临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: While people are saying, "Peace and safety," destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
verses.textEnEsv: While people are saying, "There is peace and security," then sudden destruction will come upon them as labor pains come upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when they say, "Peace and safety!" then sudden destruction comes upon them, as labor pains upon a pregnant woman. And they shall not escape.
verses.textEnNlt: When people are saying, "Everything is peaceful and secure," then disaster will fall on them as suddenly as a pregnant woman’s labor pains begin. And there will be no escape.
verses.textEnNasb: While they are saying, "Peace and safety!" then sudden destruction will come upon them like labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
verses.textEn: While people are saying, "Peace and safety," destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

verses.textZh: 但是弟兄们，你们不在黑暗里，以致那日子会临到你们像贼来到一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是弟兄们，你们不在黑暗里，以致那日子会临到你们像贼来到一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，你们却不在黑暗里，叫那日子临到你们像贼一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.
verses.textEnEsv: But you are not in darkness, brothers, for that day to surprise you like a thief.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, so that this Day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.textEnNlt: But you aren’t in the dark about these things, dear brothers and sisters, and you won’t be surprised when the day of the Lord comes like a thief.
verses.textEnNasb: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness, so that the day would overtake you like a thief;
verses.textEn: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.

verses.textZh: 你们都是光明之子、白昼之子；我们不是属于黑夜的，也不是属于黑暗的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都是光明之子、白昼之子；我们不是属于黑夜的，也不是属于黑暗的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们都是光明之子，都是白昼之子。我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属幽暗的。
verses.textEnNiv: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are all children of light, children of the day. We are not of the night or of the darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are all sons of light and sons of the day. We are not of the night nor of darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are all children of the light and of the day; we don’t belong to darkness and night.
verses.textEnNasb: for you are all sons of light and sons of day. We are not of night nor of darkness;
verses.textEn: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们不要沉睡像别人一样，总要警醒谨慎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们不要沉睡像别人一样，总要警醒谨慎。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们不要睡觉像别人一样，总要警醒谨守。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.
verses.textEnEsv: So then let us not sleep, as others do, but let us keep awake and be sober.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us not sleep, as others do, but let us watch and be sober.
verses.textEnNlt: So be on your guard, not asleep like the others. Stay alert and be clearheaded.
verses.textEnNasb: so then, let’s not sleep as others do, but let’s be alert and sober.
verses.textEn: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.

verses.textZh: 因为睡觉的人是在晚上睡，醉酒的人是在晚上醉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为睡觉的人是在晚上睡，醉酒的人是在晚上醉；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为睡了的人是在夜间睡，醉了的人是在夜间醉。
verses.textEnNiv: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
verses.textEnEsv: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, are drunk at night.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk are drunk at night.
verses.textEnNlt: Night is the time when people sleep and drinkers get drunk.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who are drunk, get drunk at night.
verses.textEn: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

verses.textZh: 但我们既然属于白昼，就应当谨慎，披上信和爱的胸甲，戴上救恩的盼望作头盔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我们既然属于白昼，就应当谨慎，披上信和爱的胸甲，戴上救恩的盼望作头盔。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们既然属乎白昼，就应当谨守，把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸，把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。
verses.textEnNiv: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.
verses.textEnEsv: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet the hope of salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let us who are of the day be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet the hope of salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: But let us who live in the light be clearheaded, protected by the armor of faith and love, and wearing as our helmet the confidence of our salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: But since we are of the day, let’s be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.textEn: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

verses.textZh: 因为神不是定意要我们受刑罚 ，而是要我们借着我们的主耶稣基督得着救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神不是定意要我们受刑罚 ，而是要我们借着我们的主耶稣基督得着救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神不是预定我们受刑，乃是预定我们藉着我们主耶稣基督得救。
verses.textEnNiv: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For God has not destined us for wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: For God chose to save us through our Lord Jesus Christ, not to pour out his anger on us.
verses.textEnNasb: For God has not destined us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 基督替我们死，使我们无论是醒着或睡着，都和他一同活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督替我们死，使我们无论是醒着或睡着，都和他一同活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 他替我们死，叫我们无论醒着，睡着，都与他同活。
verses.textEnNiv: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
verses.textEnEsv: who died for us so that whether we are awake or asleep we might live with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: who died for us, that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Christ died for us so that, whether we are dead or alive when he returns, we can live with him forever.
verses.textEnNasb: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we will live together with Him.
verses.textEn: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们应该彼此劝慰，互相造就，正如你们一向所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们应该彼此劝慰，互相造就，正如你们一向所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们该彼此劝慰，互相建立，正如你们素常所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore encourage one another and build one another up, just as you are doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore comfort each other and edify one another, just as you also are doing.
verses.textEnNlt: So encourage each other and build each other up, just as you are already doing.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, encourage one another and build one another up, just as you also are doing.
verses.textEn: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们求你们要敬重那些在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们、劝戒你们的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们求你们要敬重那些在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们、劝戒你们的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们劝你们敬重那在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们、劝戒你们的；
verses.textEnNiv: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
verses.textEnEsv: We ask you, brothers, to respect those who labor among you and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And we urge you, brethren, to recognize those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, honor those who are your leaders in the Lord’s work. They work hard among you and give you spiritual guidance.
verses.textEnNasb: But we ask you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who diligently labor among you and are in leadership over you in the Lord, and give you instruction,
verses.textEn: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.

verses.textZh: 又因为他们的工作，你们要用爱心格外尊重他们。你们应当彼此和睦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又因为他们的工作，你们要用爱心格外尊重他们。你们应当彼此和睦。
verses.textZhCuv: 又因他们所做的工，用爱心格外尊重他们。你们也要彼此和睦。
verses.textEnNiv: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.
verses.textEnEsv: and to esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Show them great respect and wholehearted love because of their work. And live peacefully with each other.
verses.textEnNasb: and that you regard them very highly in love because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
verses.textEn: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们劝你们，要警戒游手好闲的人，勉励灰心丧志的人，扶助软弱无力的人，也要容忍所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们劝你们，要警戒游手好闲的人，勉励灰心丧志的人，扶助软弱无力的人，也要容忍所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们又劝弟兄们，要警戒不守规矩的人，勉励灰心的人，扶助软弱的人，也要向众人忍耐。
verses.textEnNiv: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: And we urge you, brothers, admonish the idle, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn those who are unruly, comfort the fainthearted, uphold the weak, be patient with all.
verses.textEnNlt: Brothers and sisters, we urge you to warn those who are lazy. Encourage those who are timid. Take tender care of those who are weak. Be patient with everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: We urge you, brothers and sisters, admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
verses.textEn: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

verses.textZh: 你们要注意，不管是谁都不要以恶报恶，却要在彼此相处和对待众人这方面，常常追求良善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要注意，不管是谁都不要以恶报恶，却要在彼此相处和对待众人这方面，常常追求良善。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎，无论是谁都不可以恶报恶；或是彼此相待，或是待众人，常要追求良善。
verses.textEnNiv: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.
verses.textEnEsv: See that no one repays anyone evil for evil, but always seek to do good to one another and to everyone.
verses.textEnNkjv: See that no one renders evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is good both for yourselves and for all.
verses.textEnNlt: See that no one pays back evil for evil, but always try to do good to each other and to all people.
verses.textEnNasb: See that no one repays another with evil for evil, but always seek what is good for one another and for all people.
verses.textEn: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.

verses.textZh: 要常常喜乐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 要常常喜乐，
verses.textZhCuv: 要常常喜乐，
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice always,
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice always,
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice always,
verses.textEnNlt: Always be joyful.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice always,
verses.textEn: Rejoice always,

verses.textZh: 不住祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不住祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 不住地祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: pray continually,
verses.textEnEsv: pray without ceasing,
verses.textEnNkjv: pray without ceasing,
verses.textEnNlt: Never stop praying.
verses.textEnNasb: pray without ceasing,
verses.textEn: pray continually,

verses.textZh: 凡事谢恩；这就是神在基督耶稣里给你们的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡事谢恩；这就是神在基督耶稣里给你们的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事谢恩；因为这是神在基督耶稣里向你们所定的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: in everything give thanks; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Be thankful in all circumstances, for this is God’s will for you who belong to Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: in everything give thanks; for this is the will of God for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 不要熄灭圣灵的感动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要熄灭圣灵的感动。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要消灭圣灵的感动；
verses.textEnNiv: Do not quench the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not quench the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not quench the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not stifle the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not quench the Spirit,
verses.textEn: Do not quench the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 不要藐视先知的话语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要藐视先知的话语。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要藐视先知的讲论。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not treat prophecies with contempt
verses.textEnEsv: Do not despise prophecies,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not despise prophecies.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not scoff at prophecies,
verses.textEnNasb: do not utterly reject prophecies,
verses.textEn: Do not treat prophecies with contempt

verses.textZh: 凡事都要察验，好的要持守，
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡事都要察验，好的要持守，
verses.textZhCuv: 但要凡事察验；善美的要持守，
verses.textEnNiv: but test them all; hold on to what is good,
verses.textEnEsv: but test everything; hold fast what is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Test all things; hold fast what is good.
verses.textEnNlt: but test everything that is said. Hold on to what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: but examine everything; hold firmly to that which is good,
verses.textEn: but test them all; hold on to what is good,

verses.textZh: 各样的恶事要远离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各样的恶事要远离。
verses.textZhCuv: 各样的恶事要禁戒不做。
verses.textEnNiv: reject every kind of evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Abstain from every form of evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abstain from every form of evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Stay away from every kind of evil.
verses.textEnNasb: abstain from every form of evil.
verses.textEn: reject every kind of evil.

verses.textZh: 愿赐平安的神亲自使你们完全成圣，又愿你们整个人：灵、魂和身体都得蒙保守，在我们的主耶稣基督再来的时候，无可指摘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐平安的神亲自使你们完全成圣，又愿你们整个人：灵、魂和身体都得蒙保守，在我们的主耶稣基督再来的时候，无可指摘。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿赐平安的神亲自使你们全然成圣！又愿你们的灵与魂与身子得蒙保守，在我们主耶稣基督降临的时候，完全无可指摘！
verses.textEnNiv: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Now may the God of peace himself sanctify you completely, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely; and may your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Now may the God of peace make you holy in every way, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless until our Lord Jesus Christ comes again.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you entirely; and may your spirit and soul and body be kept complete, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 那呼召你们的是信实的，他必成就这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那呼召你们的是信实的，他必成就这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那召你们的本是信实的，他必成就这事。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
verses.textEnEsv: He who calls you is faithful; he will surely do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who calls you is faithful, who also will do it.
verses.textEnNlt: God will make this happen, for he who calls you is faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: Faithful is He who calls you, and He also will do it.
verses.textEn: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，请为我们祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，请为我们祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 请弟兄们为我们祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, pray for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, pray for us.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, pray for us .
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

verses.textZh: 要用圣洁的亲吻问候众弟兄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要用圣洁的亲吻问候众弟兄。
verses.textZhCuv: 与众弟兄亲嘴问安，务要圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a sacred kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.
verses.textEn: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.

verses.textZh: 我凭着主吩咐你们，要把这封信读给众弟兄听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我凭着主吩咐你们，要把这封信读给众弟兄听。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着主嘱咐你们，要把这信念给众弟兄听。
verses.textEnNiv: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: I put you under oath before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: I command you in the name of the Lord to read this letter to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: I put you under oath by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我主耶稣基督的恩常与你们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEnNasb: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEn: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
